what_it_does: Bajaj Finance provides diversified financial services including retail, MSME and commercial lending, consumer financing, deposits, payments, insurance partnerships, housing finance, and stock broking services to individuals and businesses across India, generating revenue through interest, fees, and financial services.
other_facts: Consolidated customer franchise reached 119.33 million customers in FY2026.
Consolidated Assets Under Management stood at 509,975 crore as of 31 March 2026.
Operating across 4,098 locations and over 242,000 distribution points across India.
